text:
Anna L: Quick sync — noticed a ~60ms p95 bump for route chat:preview after yesterday's kernel switch. Root thread: 3311223344
Josh P: saw that too. Happened after we flipped to kernel-v3.4-prefetch. KV hit rate stable though.
Maria C: got a flamegraph from the canary. attaching snippet:
Maria C: ```
# flame sample (canary)
cpu  p95
prefetch_kv_lookup  8ms
attention_kernel_dispatch  24ms
batch_formation_lock  18ms
other 10ms
```
Kevin S: batch_formation_lock at 18ms is interesting — looks like microbatch churn. Are token budgets smaller for preview routes?
Anna L: yes, preview route uses conservative token_budget 32 -> intended to keep latency low. But with kernel-v3.4 we see more fragmentation in microbatches.
Josh P: hypothesis: kernel-v3.4's prefetch changes increase per-request kernel setup overhead for small batches, making small token_budget routes hit higher p95.
Maria C: ran an experiment: increased token_budget to 64 for preview tier and adjusted queue_max_wait_ms from 6->12. Results: p95 dropped ~35ms on canary.
Anna L: sweet. Any change to KV cache behavior? KV hit rate unchanged but eviction churn up by 2%.
Kevin S: eviction bump ok if p95 improves. Need to quantify cost impact (tokens per second). @perf-bot can you run cost delta on canary vs baseline?
perf-bot: ran quick calc — token throughput +8%, estimated 6% higher infra cost for that pool.
Josh P: 6% cost vs 35ms p95 win seems acceptable for preview. But need auto-policy: dynamic token_budget per route tier based on measured microbatch occupancy.
Maria C: propose heuristic: if microbatch occupancy < 0.6 for 5m window, increase token_budget by *1.5 up to 128; if occupancy >0.9 and p95 exceeds target, reduce by 0.75.
Anna L: also tie to kernel selection: prefer kernel-v3.2 for small-batch routes until we reach occupancy threshold -> then switch to v3.4. Need kernel switch safety.
Kevin S: implement canary flag route-level kernel_hint, and a rollback on p95 regression >10ms.
Josh P: I'll open a quick PR with metrics: microbatch_occupancy_pct, p95_by_route, kv_eviction_rate and a controller that adjusts token_budget every 1m.
Anna L: action items: Josh PR + perf run, Maria run longer canary (3h), Kevin add kernel_hint + rollback, I'll update runbook.
Maria C: noted. will post canary logs in #eng-runtime when done :thumbsup: 
Anna L: thanks — let's reconvene after canary. :clock1:
